notes.title: Thank You For The Love
notes.content:
Hello!  It's been a long road to getting Sonny 1 and 2 released onto Steam, and we wanted to thank all of you so much for your support, not just now in 2024, but over the past 17 years.

We're so happy with the positive response and comments filled with nostalgia.

If you've picked up the Legacy Collection already, and given the games a (re)play...  it would mean the world to us if you could leave a review.  They help so much.

On behalf of Krin, David Orr, Dan McNeely, and everyone else who helped with both the original games and this collection, let me say again...  THANK YOU.

Stay cheeky, friends.  
- Tasselfoot

notes.title: Sonny Legacy Collection v1.0.4 - Hotfix for Audio Issues
notes.content:
We’ve identified and fixed an issue affecting the audio quality during cutscenes in both Sonny 1 and Sonny 2. Some audio streams were reset to low quality by default, primarily impacting the cutscenes. This hotfix restores those settings to higher quality, ensuring a better audio experience. You should notice the difference as soon as you play the first cutscene.

Thank you for your patience, and as always, we appreciate your feedback!
